text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Infrastructure Organisation AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × DEFENCE INFRASTRUCTURE MOD Defence Infrastructure Organisation AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK MOD Defence Infrastructure Organisation — estate management, built infrastructure, military housing, training areas, and overseas base operations. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Estate DIO Estate Portfolio Management AI 340,000-hectare MOD estate spanning 115,000 built assets valued at £20B+. Strategic estate optimisation under SDSR and Defence Estate Strategy. Surplus estate identification and disposal pipeline. Rural estate management including SSSIs and scheduled monuments. Crown land and freehold/leasehold title management. Estate rationalisation under Better Defence Estate programme. Agricultural and forestry tenancy management across training areas. Housing Service Family Accommodation AI Management of ~40,000 Service Family Accommodation (SFA) units across UK. Maintenance backlog tracking (~£1.5B estimated). Allocation algorithms respecting assignment priority, family size, and medical needs. Move-in/move-out condition survey automation. PFI contract performance monitoring. Void property management and minimisation. Forces Help to Buy integration. Substandard housing identification and tenant rehousing pathway. Training Defence Training Estate AI Management of Defence Training Estate across Salisbury Plain, Dartmoor, Sennybridge, Otterburn, Catterick, and 100+ training areas. Live firing range scheduling and safety zone management. Impact risk assessment for training exercises on civilian communities. Noise modelling and complaint management. Environmental stewardship across SSSI-designated training land. Joint training area sharing with NATO allies. Overseas Overseas Base Infrastructure AI Infrastructure management at Gibraltar, Cyprus (Akrotiri/Dhekelia), Falkland Islands, Germany (BFG residual), and global sites. Sovereign Base Area administration under Treaty of Establishment. Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) compliance. Host nation infrastructure access agreements. Overseas estate condition survey programme. Climate resilience for tropical and sub-arctic bases. Forward mounting base infrastructure for rapid deployment. Sustainability MOD Estate Decarbonisation AI MOD Net Zero 2050 pathway aligned with Greening Government Commitments. Carbon baseline measurement across estate. Renewable energy integration (solar, wind, biomass) on MOD land. Electric vehicle fleet transition. Biodiversity net gain under Environment Act 2021. Flood risk management and SuDS. Sustainable construction standards (BREEAM). Green procurement for DIO supply chain. Digital Digital Twin Estate Modelling AI Digital twin creation for major MOD sites. BIM Level 2 compliance for all new MOD construction. GIS estate-wide spatial data platform. LiDAR and photogrammetric survey. IoT sensor integration for building performance monitoring. Space utilisation analytics. Predictive degradation modelling for building fabric and M&E systems. Augmented reality for maintenance technician field work. Maintenance Planned & Reactive Maintenance AI PFI contract management (National Housing Prime, Allenby/Connaught). Planned preventative maintenance scheduling across 115,000 assets. Reactive maintenance prioritisation using risk-based triage. Asbestos management compliance. Legionella risk assessment. Fire safety remediation post-Grenfell. Roof, window, and building envelope lifecycle replacement. Emergency maintenance protocols for critical infrastructure.
